label: Pass rate
basis: passed tests over executed tests (skipped tests excluded)

label: Requirement coverage
basis: requirements with at least one approved test case over all requirements

label: Script executability
basis: scripts whose test ran to a pass or a fail (no error) over scripts generated

label: Healing success rate
basis: steps with a proposed locator over steps that asked for healing

label: Classification accuracy
basis: failures whose category equals the supplied label over labelled failures

label: Generation latency (median)
basis: analyze and generate steps of the three generation components, LLM time included

label: LLM call latency (median)
basis: gateway calls to the provider (mock or live, see the provider label)

label: API cost
basis: sum of token costs of the runs involved (zero for the mock provider)

label: API cost per run
basis: API cost divided by the 2 run(s) involved
